parameters.name: list_files
parameters.description: List files in a directory. Input: JSON object with path field.

parameters.name: read_file
parameters.description: Read file contents. Input: JSON object with path field. Do NOT use for files already in context.

parameters.name: write_file
parameters.description: Create or overwrite a file. Input: JSON object with filePath and content fields.

parameters.name: str_replace_file
parameters.description: Search and replace text in a file. Input: JSON object with filePath, search, and replace fields. Search must match EXACTLY.

parameters.name: delete_file
parameters.description: Delete a file. Input: JSON object with path field.

parameters.name: search_files
parameters.description: Search for text in the codebase. Input: JSON object with query field.

parameters.name: add_dependency
parameters.description: Install an npm package. Input: JSON object with package field.
